resources.string: Tap a pair to name it. The first app opens on top, or on the left, and the second beside it.
No pairs yet. In the keyboard\'s app launcher, press and hold an app, pick Pair in split screen with…, then tap the second app.
Split screen from the keyboard needs Android 12L or later, or the split screen helper on the App launcher page. Pairs on this phone open only their first app.
